answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 14101 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: I belong to hanafi fiqa, can i do masah of my feets during wazu ,my shoes are uptill ancakle height and made of leather. Question: I belong to hanafi fiqa, can i do masah of my feets during wazu ,my shoes are uptill ancakle height and made of leather. Answer ID: 14101 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1081/1022=B/1430) You can perform masah (wipe with wet hands) if your shoes are made of leather, they cover the feet till over the ankles, they are clean and you put on it after full taharah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
